texts: Lumen Notes has three plans. The Free plan includes 2 GB of storage and works on up to 3 devices.
The Plus plan costs $6 per month and includes 50 GB of storage on unlimited devices. The Team plan costs
$10 per member per month. Each Team member gets 100 GB of storage, and the plan adds an admin console
for managing members and shared notebooks. Paying yearly instead of monthly gives a 20% discount on Plus and Team. You
can switch plans at any time from Settings, Billing. When you upgrade, the new storage limit applies immediately and you
pay the difference for the rest of the billing period. When you downgrade, the change takes effect at the end
of the current period, and notes above the new storage limit become read-only until you free up space.

You can cancel a paid plan at any time from Settings, Billing. Monthly plans are not refunded: after you cancel,
you keep access until the end of the month you paid for, and you are not charged again. Yearly plans
can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. After 14 days, a cancelled yearly plan stays active until
the end of the year and is not renewed. Refunds go back to the original payment method and usually arrive
within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank. If you were charged twice for the same period, contact
support with both receipt numbers and we will refund the duplicate charge.

If a payment fails, Lumen shows an error code that starts with B. Error B-402 means your card was declined
by your bank; check the card details or try another card. Error B-409 means the payment was already processed, so
you were not charged twice. Error B-503 means our payment provider is temporarily unavailable; wait a few minutes and try
again. We retry a failed renewal payment three times over seven days. If all three attempts fail, your plan moves
to Free and notes above the Free storage limit become read-only. Your notes are never deleted because of a failed
payment.

To reset your password, choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and we will email you a reset link. The
link is valid for 30 minutes and can be used once. We strongly recommend two-factor authentication, which asks for a
six-digit code from an authenticator app each time you sign in on a new device. When you turn it on,
you receive 10 recovery codes. Each recovery code works once, so store them somewhere safe and offline. After 5 failed
sign-in attempts in a row, your account is locked for 15 minutes to slow down password guessing. Lumen staff will
never ask you for your password or a recovery code.

When you sign up, we send a verification email. The verification link is valid for 24 hours; after that, sign
in and choose Resend email. You can choose which notifications you receive in Settings, Notifications. Shared notebook invitations are sent
by email and expire after 7 days if they are not accepted. A weekly summary of your recent notes is
sent every Monday unless you turn it off. We never send marketing email without your consent, and every message has
an unsubscribe link at the bottom.

Notes you edit offline are saved on your device and sync automatically when you reconnect. If the same note was
changed on two devices while they were offline, Lumen keeps both versions and adds a conflicted copy next to the
original, so no text is lost. Sync errors show a short code. Error E-402 means your storage quota is full:
delete notes or attachments, or upgrade your plan, and sync resumes. Error E-409 means a sync conflict that Lumen could
not resolve by itself; open the note and choose which version to keep. Error E-503 means our servers are temporarily
unavailable; the app retries on its own with increasing delays, and you do not need to do anything.

You can export any notebook as Markdown files or as a single PDF from the notebook menu. Developers can also
read and write notes through the Lumen API. Create an API token in Settings, Developer. Tokens expire after 90 days,
and you can revoke one at any time. Each token can make up to 60 requests per minute. Requests above
that limit receive HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests, with a Retry-After header that says how many seconds to wait.
Attachments larger than 25 MB can't be uploaded through the API; use the desktop app for those. The API never
returns notes from notebooks the token's owner can't open.
